objective: Review the direct-launch handoff implementation boundary after the honest direct_launch_handoff_failure run and decide whether a narrow implementation fixture may be attempted without claiming direct Verilator sidecar execution.

review_decision.reason: The definition is narrow enough to review before code changes. It only allows a future implementation to connect validated native parser payload, explicit pulp_ita_mha 64x1 sidecar context, reviewed stage authority, and the existing sidecar stage launcher.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still boundary review, not execution. The direct native path has not launched sidecar stages or reached coverage-output compare. The next implementation must remain a fixture-level handoff until a later run proves the authority chain.
accepted_because: the source gate explicitly starts from an honest direct_launch_handoff_failure record
the implementation surface is limited to the native-invocation fixture, the existing sidecar launcher path, and shared sidecar option mapping
generated command text, stage-plan metadata, parser success, wrapper execution, reports, and artifacts remain non-authoritative by themselves
the scope remains pulp_ita_mha 64x1 and coverage_output_equivalence
timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain non-claims

required_next_gate.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_fixture_gate
must_implement: a non-executing fixture that represents parser-payload to sidecar-launcher handoff readiness
explicit validation that target/template/shape/source context is present before launcher handoff metadata is produced
explicit flags proving the fixture did not execute sidecar stages or compare outputs
preserved failure classes for missing context, authority mismatch, handoff failure, stage failure, and compare failure

non_claims: not broad native Verilator option support
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
